notes: Renamed: EDGAR shows Stoicheia, Inc. from 2021-02-10 to 2022-07-29, then Mattiq, Inc. (CIK 1843720, Delaware, incorporated 2020). A 'stoicheia-rebrand-to-mattiq' post was captured 2023-03.

HQ moved from Skokie, IL (8140 McCormick Blvd in 2020, 8045 Lamon Ave in 2022) to 400 N. Aberdeen St, Chicago (2024 Form D). A 'new headquarters in Chicago's downtown deep science hub' post was captured 2024-03.
Form D total: about USD 18.6M across three offerings (2020, 2022, 2024). No priced round has been publicly announced since the USD 5M seed in Jan 2021.
Non-dilutive funding exists but amounts were not retrieved: a DOE HPC4EI award (captured 2023-09) and a 'pipeline of grant wins' post (captured 2023-09).

Strategic partner: Heraeus Precious Metals, a low-iridium PEM electrocatalyst partnership announced 2025-01-30 and first announced as a collaboration in 2023. The site cites 1,000+ h electrolyzer validation and a 60% iridium reduction.
